summary: Iteration 5 — Full backend + frontend testing of in-app notifications + CSV exports. Wrote pytest suite test_notifications_exports.py (16 tests). All 13 critical tests PASS (notifications CRUD + auth, all event hooks, finances CSV export, tracking regression). 3 pre-existing CSV export endpoints (delivery-requests/riders/merchants) return 500 — marked xfail (NOT a new regression; root cause: csv.DictWriter pulls fieldnames from items[0].keys() but documents have varying schemas). Combined with existing pytest: 55 passed, 3 xfailed. Frontend: NotificationBell renders post-login, panel opens, mark-all-read clears badge, export-finances-btn visible on Finances tab, public delivery POST creates admin notification visible in bell, login toast now correctly says 'Administrateur GoLiv'.

critical.issue: Return 500 Internal Server Error. csv.DictWriter uses fieldnames=items[0].keys() but later docs have additional fields (e.g. livraisons_en_cours, user_id, total_commandes). PRE-EXISTING bug — not introduced this iteration, but blocks the admin Livreurs/Commerçants/Livraisons CSV export buttons. Fix: collect union of all keys OR add extrasaction='ignore' with an explicit header list (same pattern used by the new /api/admin/export/finances which works correctly).

ui_bugs.issue: Desktop navbar at 1440px still overflows — 'Demander une livraison' CTA is clipped to 'Deman...' at right edge. This is the SAME HIGH issue reported in iteration_4. Addition of NotificationBell pushed the layout further. Recommend hiding the CTA below xl breakpoint OR removing one nav link OR reducing gap.

rca of the issue: EXPORT 500 RCA — Reproduction: curl '{BASE}/api/admin/export/riders?password=plb2024' → 500. Backend log shows ValueError: dict contains fields not in fieldnames: 'livraisons_en_cours', 'total_livraisons'. Root cause: server.py uses csv.DictWriter(fieldnames=items[0].keys()) at lines 1666, 1686, 1706, 1726 — but in real data the first document is missing fields that later documents have (e.g. a rider created before livraisons_en_cours counter increments has the field; one created earlier doesn't). When DictWriter.writerows hits a row with extra keys, it raises. Fix: either (a) compute union of keys: fieldnames = list({k for d in items for k in d.keys()}), or (b) use the same pattern as the new finances export — explicit static headers + extrasaction='ignore'. Option (b) is cleaner. NEW EXPORT NOT AFFECTED — /api/admin/export/finances at lines 1966-1990 uses option (b) and works correctly.
